propositions: The compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext by the review-bot when sourced from query parameters (?token=), and must be rotated after the fix (66af) is deployed to production.
The 66af fix moves credential sourcing from the query string to the X-Rebar-Token header and adds TokenRedactingFilter to prevent plaintext logging.

The token serves three concurrent purposes (HTTP basic-auth password, inbound webhook secret, container environment variable) and must be rotated atomically via service-user.sh to avoid desynchronization.
Rotation must follow deployment of 66af to production to prevent the new token from being immediately re-leaked by the old logging behavior.
The rotation sequence requires: deploy 66af, rotate via service-user.sh, restart the review-bot container, and verify both inbound webhooks and outbound LLM-Review votes work with the new credential.
